feeds.title: Chicago Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Chicago Fine Art Blog informs us about all the art forms of Chicago like EXPO CHICAGO and all the detailed information about it. This blog is by Charles Gniech, a Professor of Graphic Design at Joliet Junior College. His work has been included in numerous gallery and museum exhibitions repeatedly included at both The Rockford Art Museum and The Fort Wayne Museum of Art.

feeds.title: The Arts Club of Chicago Blog
feeds.description: The Arts Club of Chicago has been a preeminent exhibitor of international art, a forum for established and emerging artists, and a celebrated venue for performers from around the world. Our blog informs you about the artists, exhibitions, events held by different artists, and many more!

feeds.title: Bad at Sports Blog
feeds.description: Bad at Sports was established in the year 2005 and since then it is a weekly podcast and blog produced in Chicago that features artists talking about art and the community that makes, reviews, and critiques it.

feeds.title: FAD Magazine » Chicago Art
feeds.description: FAD Magazine covers all the news and latest updates about Chicago Art. It also shares contemporary art- News, Exhibitions, Interviews, and cool art stuff reported on from London.

feeds.title: Hyde Park Art Center
feeds.description: Hyde Park Art Center is a hub for contemporary arts in Chicago, serving as a gathering and production space for artists and the broader community to cultivate ideas, impact social change, and connect with new networks. Our mission is to stimulate and sustain the visual arts in Chicago.

feeds.title: The Visualist
feeds.description: The Visualist shares art calendars every day on different topics like Qieer Art Party, Sunday Series, Memorial for Victims of Police Violence, No One Ever Sees Indians: Native Americans in Media, Artist Talk: Dan Peterman and others, Pious Work of Salvage, and many more!

feeds.title: Bateman Art Blog
feeds.description: Bateman School is dedicated to empowering responsible and respectful, lifelong learners in a rigorous learning environment where ownership for academic, technological, social, and emotional development is shared by all. Our mission is to cultivate a holistic education, provide challenging academic programs supporting a safe learning environment, foster globally-minded leaders, and instill a desire to be lifelong learners. Our blog posts contain art shared and made by different students.

feeds.title: Laura Lynne Art Blog
feeds.description: Read the Laura Lynne Art blog now for an inside glimpse into how Laura creates her work and more on her murals. It is a Journey of Whimsy and Color. Welcome to my whimsical imaginings of nature and animals! The art I create is inspired by the deep connection with nature I developed as a child, poems, song lyrics, fairy tales, and poster design.

feeds.title: Newcity Art
feeds.description: Get all the unsurpassed coverage of contemporary art in Chicago, including profiles of artists and gallerists, features, essays, and more reviews of Chicago art shows. Newcity Art is a Web site dedicated to news, reviews, and features about Chicago's visual art world.

feeds.title: Kevin Swallow Urban Landscapes Blog
feeds.description: Kevin Swallow Blog provides blogs on art, paintings, photographs, and mixed media by Kevin Swallow. His art is influenced by the unlimited sights, sounds, and colors of the city working to capture the textures and sensations of the urban landscape. He draws inspiration and ideas from the city environment, music, architecture, abstract expressionism, pop art, street art/graffiti, and technology.

feeds.title: Chicago Public Art Blog
feeds.description: Chicago Public Art Blog is one of the most comprehensive guides to outdoor public art in the city of Chicago. The blog posts are all about art structures and detailed information on them like Lions, Batcolumn, Abraham Lincoln, the Head of State (Seated Lincoln), Bust of Jean Baptiste Pointe DuSable, and more!

feeds.title: Bridgeport Art Center
feeds.description: Bridgeport Art Center is an inspiring place for artists, fashion designers, & creative professionals to find space to work, create, & share ideas. This historic and visually breathtaking Chicago building defines raw urban elegance and features three curated Art Galleries, Artist Studios, the Fashion Design Center, and more!

feeds.title: Artist Anne Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Anne Nordhaus a painter and mixed-media artist. Here, on Artist Anne Blog, I blog about my work and my life and how they intermingle to create art. The mystery of made things fascinates me, even after decades of looking at, studying, and creating art. I want to show others what intrigues me, help them see through my eyes, and hear the echoes of my soul within their own.

feeds.title: Hofheimer Gallery
feeds.description: Know about current and future art exhibitions at the Hofheimer gallery. Our art gallery in Chicago features provocative, engaging, solo, and group exhibitions for artists in Chicago. We're an online art consulting business managed by artist and curator, Teresa Hofheimer. The gallery is dedicated to introducing contemporary fine art in painting, drawing, and mixed media from established artists.

feeds.title: Jeannie Hua Artist Blog
feeds.description: Jeannie Hua is currently an MFA candidate at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago in the low residency program. She is an artist recording truths as she sees them using various mediums including but not lim.

feeds.title: Artmill Group Blog
feeds.description: Artmill Group provides end-to-end art production, custom framing, conservation, and design services to a range of clients in the fine art, commercial, corporate, design, educational, hospitality, and insurance industries. By combining the strengths, skill sets, and decades of experience of its predecessor companies, Artmill Group delivers an unparalleled and seamless set of art production alternatives.

feeds.title: Artists on the Lam Blog
feeds.description: Artists on the Lam Blog is by Jenny Lam a critically and publicly acclaimed self-taught award-winning multidisciplinary artist, and more. She works towards championing local artists; channeling global perspectives. Her mission is to make art accessible and a vision to bring people together,

feeds.title: Wonder City Studio Blog
feeds.description: Drawings with Chicago themes, architecture, illustrated maps, and marathon course maps. Wonder City Studio Blog shares building renderings and all sorts of things. We create artwork that honors the architecture and history of places worth preserving, with a special love for Chicago. We help our clients honor cherished homes, buildings, neighborhoods, and cities; and we partner with organizations with similar missions.

feeds.title: DeGroot Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: DFA provides comprehensive art consulting and advising services for both corporate and private clients. Our goal is to help build and shape collections to align with each client's unique vision and values. Our fine art consultants work with corporate and private clients to manage art collections and provide creative collaborations that enrich the workspace, home, and local art community.
